subject: Metaheuristic Approaches
source_sentence: Ours is the first extrinsic evaluation of any metaheuristic approaches to WSD in a lexical substitution setting.
title: Metaheuristic Approaches to Lexical Substitution and Simpliﬁcation

subject: Lexical Substitution
source_sentence: Most lexical substitution systems therefore comprise two distinct phases: generation, in which the system assembles a set of suitable substitutes for the target word, and ranking, in which the system orders them according to how well they fit the context.
title: Metaheuristic Approaches to Lexical Substitution and Simpliﬁcation
